title: Louis XIII to Melchior de Sabran, Dijon, 28 March 1631, BnF Baluze 155 f. 79-80 (DECODE R2748)

steps.what: Fetched the DECODE record view for R2748 and its four images (Gallica scans of Baluze 155 f. 79-80) with the shared cookie.

Checked Tomokiyo's louisxiii.htm (DECODE's pointer) and GL.htm: R2748 solved by George Lasry in 2022, key and decipherment as images; the same cipher in Sabran's letters, fr. 4134 and fr. 4135. Entry closed without applying the key.

Split from the former combined target louis1615 (catalogue 191) under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R2748 (the 1631 Sabran cipher, Lasry's solution) and R2785/R2786 (the Brulart de Leon cipher of 1615-18, Tomokiyo's key) are different ciphers. Folder, profile, page and ledgers separated; earlier steps kept as recorded. Lasry's three GL.htm images fetched to summarise the content.

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry's 2022 decipherment of both cipher passages, published as an overlay on the f. 79 image on Tomokiyo's GL.htm; nothing was deciphered here and his key was not re-applied.
outcome.notes: Lasry's decipherment covers both passages; not re-checked sign by sign. Nothing new about the text. Catalogue entry 191 removed 21 Sept 2026.
